S1:27.text: When they were gone forth, the other ſonnes of Iacob ranne in vpon them that were thaine: and ſpoiled the citie in revengce of the rape.

S1:28.text: And waſting al things that were in their houſes, and fildes, their ſheepe and heardes heardes, and aſſes,

S1:29.text: their little ones alſo, and their wiues they led away captiue.

S1:30.text: which things when they had boldly atcheiued, Iacob ſaid to Simeon and Leui You haue trubled me, and made me odious to the Chananites, and Pherezites the inhabiteres of this land. we are few: they being gethered together wil ſtrike me and I, and my houſe ſhal be deſtroyed.

S1:31.text: They anſwered What ſhould they abuſe our ſiſter as a ſtrumpet?

S1:4.text: And going to Hemor his father, he ſaid: Take me this wench to be my wife

S1:6.text: And when Hemor Sichems father was conie forth to ſpeake vnto Iacob,

S3:2.text: Whom when Sichem had ſeene the ſonne of Hemor the Heuite, the prince of that land, he was in loue with her: and he tooke her away, and lay with her, by force rauiſhing the virgin.

S3:24.text: And they al aſſented, and circumciſed at the man ſex.

S3:27.text: When they were gone forth, the other ſonnes of Iacob ranne in vpon them that were ſlaine and ſpoiled the citie in revengue of therape.

S3:29.text: their little ones alſo, and their wiues they led away captiue.

S3:30.text: Which things when they had boldly atcheiued, Iacob ſaid to Simeon and Leui You haue trubled me, and made me odious to the Chananites, and Pherezites the inhabitants of this land. we are few: they being gethered together wil ſtrike me and I, and my houſe ſhal be deſtroyed.

S3:4.text: And going to Hemor his father, he ſaid Take me this wench to be my wiſe. †

S3:6.text: And when Hemor Sichems father was come forth to ſpeake vnto Iacob,

S6:12.text: raiſe the dowrie, and require guifts, and I ſhal gladly giue what you ſhal demand: onely giue me this wench to wife.

S6:13.text: Iacobs ſonnes anſwered Sichem & his father in guile, being wrath for the deflouring of their ſiſter

S6:2.text: Whom when Sichem had ſeen, the ſonne of Hemor the Heuite, the Prince of that land, he was in loue with her and he tooke her away, and lay with her, by force rauiſhing the virgin.

S6:26.text: murdered withal Hemor and Sichem, taking away Dina their ſiſter out of Sichems houſe.

S6:3.text: And his ſoule was faſt knit vnto her, and wheras ſhe was ſad, he comforted her with ſweet words.

S9:18.text: The offer pleaſed Hemor, and Sichem his ſonne:

S9:19.text: neither did the young man make delay, but forthwith fulfilled that which was demanded for he loued the wench exceedingly, and he was the greateſt man in al his fathers houſe.
